swimming_pool.evidence: Turquoise rectangular/kidney-shaped water surface with a light coping border, just west of the central house.

detached_structure.evidence: Small gray-roofed structure at the left edge of the lot, northwest of the pool, which may be a shed or outbuilding, though it could belong to the neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The house has a dark, multi-wing roof and an in-ground pool on the west side. Mature trees surround the lot on most sides, and a paved driveway on the south side holds two vehicles.
